failedAttemptsDisclosed: Initial pip launcher had a missing interpreter; used python -m pip without changing project code.
Node24 default test reporter caused the coinbot control parser to fail; used the project-required Node22.
Outer npm exec -c leaked its call configuration to a nested npx Worker dry run, causing EUSAGE. Switched to the actual Node22 binary; Worker dry run then passed.
